notes.title: New military inventions of CRONUS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Welcome, employees and first residents of the Dome!

On your screens the new issue of the "CRONUS Weekly". Today we will continue the section about amazing inventions and tell you about the latest and boldest novelties in the military industry.

[h1]Cryo Grenades Field Tests[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/e6e0e1c50d66af06c463bbfe82744c087ca54b79.jpg[/img]

Wesley Industries once again proves that nothing is impossible, and takes on the implementation of the most daring ideas of the Black Wing. Until recently, ordinary privates only joked about miraculous freezing grenades, and today this weapon is ready for field use! A single accurate throw, and even a big squad cannot escape from the battlefield.

[h1]Hydraulic Power Gloves[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/19dc8d841481efcd2a3524aa37d961c3d35f8cfc.jpg[/img]

Hydraulic glove is another bold invention of the best CRONUS engineers. While everyone around the world has to rent expensive loading equipment, CRONUS employees can handle any medium or lightweight load with one hand. One person armed with such a useful item can replace up to three forklift trucks. All this became possible only thanks to relics and artifacts left by the Forefathers.

[h1]First Servoshell Concept[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/71b6bbf8791829fad035862d9fd747f08bca1d3b.jpg[/img]

You have already heard the accusations against CRONUS many times, allegedly in almost all our inventions there is an obvious military potential. But it's worth examining early blueprints to understand that rumors are clearly exaggerated. For example, servoshell was first introduced to the world as a means to handle heavy loads, and additional metal plates were only needed to protect employees during heavy and dangerous work.

Unfortunately, the Dome was not as hospitable as we thought, and all military prototypes were approved by CRONUS only to protect their employees.

See you under the Dome!

notes.title: Back to the roots. Forward to the brighter future!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear readers, this letter may seem familiar to you, even if you see it for the first time. After all, on your screens is the [b]50th-anniversary[/b] issue of the CRONUS weekly! Today there’s no news, just memories of the very first issue.

[h1](ARCHIVE!) The opening ceremony of the Dome was attended by more than 10 thousand settlers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/8a255ba00001f0a79644b5cd2b7421f6116730ee.jpg[/img]

On September 26, the Dome was opened for the first researchers. More than ten thousand settlers went to build a bright world of the future. There is a lot of work ahead, mysterious artifacts and supernatural anomalies will one day submit to the intelligence of researchers and will be converted for the benefit of mankind. We ask you to join us, too!

[i][b]Comment from the present:[/b] Just imagine, not so long ago there were only 10,000 of us. Just imagine how much work each of us has done to create the largest world corporation, consisting of representatives of all nations. Together we are building the future for all humanity.
[/i]

[h1](ARCHIVE!) Bugs fixed[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/83b4e15284a3724fc4d21bbcaef2f6f3074e4a9f.jpg[/img]

The best minds of CRONUS believe that true mastery lies not in avoiding mistakes, but in correcting them in time. So our best specialists work tirelessly to improve the quality of life of each settler. Many errors and bugs have already been fixed.

[i][b]Comment from the present:[/b] Since the release of this material, the management of the corporation has implemented three major infrastructure upgrades and many additional changes. Together we make our lives better![/i]

[h1](ARCHIVE!) More than 85% of the first settlers are satisfied with the quality of life under the Dome[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/2f7ff824ccdcd0b53058b8f6e7d08e1b5b11fabe.jpg[/img]

An independent user survey proved a high level of satisfaction with the living conditions under the Dome. 85% of users left positive reviews. CRONUS corporation is grateful and promises to maintain a high level of responsibility!

[i][b]Comment from the present:[/b] And it was only the beginning! Even now, independent surveys under the Dome show 99.9% satisfaction with living and working conditions![/i]

[h1]C.R.O.N.U.S. Weekly is not the only way to monitor corporation updates[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/2fa03f508ab2cc902b73af386ba8f1525ff645c6.jpg[/img]

We hope you got the same nostalgia trip as we did and urge everyone to share materials about our projects on social networks in order to invite the best specialists to our team. In addition, subscribe to our social networks to be the first to know about project updates.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers, the latest issue of the CRONUS weekly is once again on your screens. In this issue you will learn how excavations under the Dome are progressing, about the new and incredibly useful invention of Wesley industries, as well as how the training program for new recruits is changing.

[h1]Compact harpoon from Wesley Industries[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/52bcf1e0ace9b6ad422ef4fba716d6d3e0580304.png[/img]

The Dome is full of dangers, cliffs and high mountains. But what are you going to do if you notice an artifact of the Forefathers or a unique anomaly in the abyss? How do you get to it?

This is the question that Wesley company has answered with their new invention — a miniature harpoon. It is convenient, powerful, and most importantly — compact. The administration of CRONUS recommends it to any wasteland researcher.

[h1]Excavation under the Dome[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/4f110c3ee154bb1dccb1c03c5d68b6ff543b4c09.jpg[/img]

The hardest and most dangerous excavations under the Dome are carried out by the Orange Wing under the careful supervision of scientists. In case of emergency, the life of each employee is insured. Relatives and friends of the deceased will receive compensation at any CRONUS station under the Dome.

[h1]CRONUS training program[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/73c6cb0db6e333d673723f27b523c94429c90357.jpg[/img]

notes.title: History of power armor creation. Community support. New sightseeing routes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers, CRONUS weekly is once again on your terminals. Today we will show you how servoshell has been improved over the years of development under the Dome. We will discuss new interesting places for expeditions and scientific researches, as well as celebrate the modest achievement of our first settlers.

[h1]From prototype to production. History of power armor transformations.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/baff5c9f88caf9c739c03f2763636352ff4264b0.gif[/img]

Servoshell is one of the main achievements of Blue Wing engineers. High-tech suit is not only protecting against radiation and harmful effects of anomalies. It also allows people to carry cargo beyond the limits of human capabilities and perform complex engineering tasks.

However, the servoshell wasn’t always like the one we have today. It has come a long way from the first sketches, to the launch of full-scale production. Now these suits serve for the benefit of all humanity.

[i]Note: all rumors about the great military potential are overly exaggerated. Servoshell was made solely for industrial purposes.[/i]

[h1]Places to visit under the Dome[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/2a1624e29c069e754c19c16914a2382f1aade47f.jpg[/img]

So, where should you go right away? We recommend picturesque grottoes with anomalies. Truly amazing place! But do not hurry to go on an expedition. Every newcomer must be instructed and get permission before leaving the station.

[h1]800 reviews! New milestone for the community![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c73c39cdae8ac15fa158154e7d9f4b73f1ff5e96.png[/img]

notes.title: Cinema premiers without risk for your health
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers and residents of the Dome, the latest issue of "CRONUS Weekly" is once again on your screens. Today we will talk about the revival of cultural life, discoveries of biologists and testing of the panacea.

[h1]Return of movie theaters[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5d892ca460ccc6f043e6343a0cd95984738b0042.png[/img]

When we say that the Dome has become a new center of the world, it’s not only because of science and technology. We know how important it is to support culture and art, that's why we are happy to present the first full-length film made under the Dome.

Deader than dead is an exciting adventure movie, highly appreciated by cultural consultants of the Silver Wing. The film combines an exciting plot and a deep humanistic message. The movie is fully filmed and edited under the Dome, and its actors instantly became worldwide stars! You can watch this unique artistic expression very soon in any cinema around the globe or on the screens of your terminals with an extended subscription to CRONUS originals.

[h1]Cockroach soldier[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/8b8521b45ec1f48498f2191977d0137d963a8bc0.png[/img]

In the past, when we were all afraid of a possible atomic war, everyone knew that cockroaches could survive even a nuclear winter. Thanks to the discovery of the Dome, world powers maintain a balance, but cockroaches can still surprise us!

Truth to be told, they evolve rapidly under the influence of the Dome environment. For example, look at this handsome guy! In the hive, he takes the role of a soldier. On his head he has spikes that can penetrate the car metal, and his shell is difficult to break for the most ordinary bullets. Fortunately, everything is under control, and White Wing biologists control every creature. These mutants won’t be able to escape!

[h1]Cure for all diseases[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/3d851ef22c9beddf74fc6fff0bd8c4b1959809ae.png[/img]

Just 10 years ago, a person could die from an infection with a simple splinter. You had to drink tons of medicines and hope for the best if you wanted to cure yourself. The technologies found under the Dome have turned our idea of medical science upside down. Now most diseases, injuries and even gunshot wounds can be cured in a matter of hours with medical bags.

A brand new Stimpack is looking for volunteers for testing. This is a simple formality that will cure the test subjects of any illness. White Wing physicians claim it to be harmless and with no side effects. The device has already been tested by the top executives of the corporation. Now it's your turn!

[h1]New expedition[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c715ee263bdce366cb4b0c0929fc5313ea306f2f.png[/img]

The world of the future calls for the strongest! On September 24, the Against The Moon universe will open its gates for pathfinders.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1039480/Against_The_Moon/

Chthonic monsters of the Moon run rampant on the Earth. Only brave defenders can resist the infinitely strong enemy. Intelligent Arx citadel asks for your help, brave employees. Throw the invader a challenge in card battles, sacrifice heroes for the common good and control three characters at once. The whole planet has risen to repel the invasion and fight the last battle Against The Moon!

notes.title: Catastrophe that changed the world
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Welcome, subscribers and first settlers of the Dome!

Once again the latest issue of the CRONUS weekly is on your screens. In this issue we will tell you how mankind discovered the Dome, pay special attention to the recruit combat training, as well as show you inner workings of one of the most important CRONUS laboratories.


[h1]Catastrophe that changed the world[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c068c64d75a68133b4ae513fa2cffc47a482d360.jpg[/img]

Walking around the Crystal Sands, newcomers can’t even imagine that a few years ago, in place of all these buildings, laboratories and training grounds, stretched a lifeless desert. In a short time CRONUS managed to build an infrastructure, which had no analogues in the world.

The Dome was found by chance: Everything began with the mysterious disappearance of the military aircraft. It was reported that the pilot lost his course during the sandstorm. Two rescue helicopters went to search, but both crashed. Only one crew member survived. He reported that one of the vehicles allegedly crashed against an "invisible wall" and, while falling, hit the second helicopter.

This is how mankind first encountered the Dome, a mysterious construction of an unknown civilization.

[h1]Self-defence lessons[/h1]

[previewyoutube=KLF1QOV-ZYs;full][/previewyoutube]

Employees! We remind you that combat training is a guarantee of survival in a harsh and dangerous world under the Dome. It seems that some of you have been negligent in your training with holograms, which resulted in significant losses during the last mission. CRONUS does not tolerate repeated errors. Each recruit now has to watch a specially made video course by the best Black Wing team. Follow the instructions and become a real war machine in no time.

[h1]Emulator project control room[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/34d9b346bdebb43214f2b789856ec5d6932408f6.png[/img]

Dear subscribers. Today we managed to look behind the scenes of, perhaps, one of the most important rooms under the Dome. On your screens, the anomaly research project control room. Here the best minds of the corporation are developing technologies based on resources left by the ancient civilization. Each scientist or engineer is ready to part with a quiet life under the Dome, just to touch the secrets of the forgotten civilization and help the project to control the anomalous nature of the Dome.

notes.title: Forefathers mysteries, anomalies and artifacts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Welcome, dear subscribers. Once again "CRONUS Weekly" is on your terminals. Today we’ll focus on mysteries of the Forefathers, anomalies and artifacts. In recent video chronicles, we told you how you can get the most valuable inventions for your personal use. If you missed it, we advise you to watch it immediately.

[previewyoutube=aAABptCQKSw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Forefathers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5d5412fe34d6731c2428ced626ca5262c45cef89.png[/img]

Almost everyone who has heard of the Dome at least once asks a question: where did all these technological wonders come from? Unfortunately, no one, even the best minds of humanity, is ready to answer this question. We call the creators of the Dome the Forefathers and know too little about them.

Every day, the best scientists of the White Wing carefully study the technologies left by the Forefathers to turn them for the benefit of humanity. Even today, dozens of amazing inventions are ready to be transported to the outside world, and it is you, our readers, who can become their first owners.

[h1]Holographic projector[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/12979f6d9801efa0d9e3d6053dacf5b08d3a5c86.png[/img]

Holographic projector is one of the new advanced technologies of the Wesley industries, a real breakthrough in data transmission. In a few days it gained popularity in almost all areas under the Dome. Officers of the Black Wing especially liked it. The presentations of new models of weapons and armor have never attracted so much attention before.

Projectors are especially useful in the training of recruits, the battles with holograms are absolutely safe, but they allow to create situations as close to reality as possible.

[h1]Anomalies[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/31c994407fafc943fd8db94eb88bf1543a987281.jpg[/img]

Anomalies, perhaps, are the main secret of the Dome. Despite the huge budgets that CRONUS allocates to study, we still know too little about their properties. Risking their lives, every day dozens of researchers go to the wastelands to study these wonders some more.

You may have already encountered some anomalies at the Concord station. Here, every newcomer, under the strict control of scientists, must understand what he’ll soon face.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.828.1606: Following in the footsteps of user bug reports
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/6ecd626882caca019089c90adbee21b997bf489b.jpg[/img]

From the very beginning of the game’s development, our community has been actively involved in the work on Encased, proposing marvelously insane weapon ideas, interesting encounters and exciting new characters (we even added some of them to the game).

But perhaps the biggest contribution to the development came from users who sent us bug reports. Thank you for helping make Encased even better, more stable, and more player-friendly.

Below is a list of changes that we made to the game along with the fresh hotfix:

[h3]LOCATIONS[/h3]

[*] Fixed freezing of the necroid in the sewer under the Roadside Picnic,
[*] Fixed the appearance of the necroid from the grave at Roadside Picnic,
[*] Fixed radiation aura at the grave necroid at Roadside Picnic,
[*] Fixed stairs in the basement of Bradbury station
[*] Fixed the process of player’s detection near the boxes on the third exit of the Concord station,
[*] Fixed the radius of detection for characters at the Concord station,
[*] Fixed passability on the Laboratory floor of the Magellan station,
[/list]

notes.title: Emergency weather report. Management visit with inspection.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers, once again the latest issue of the CRONUS Weekly is on your terminals. Today we will tell you how the weather affects anomalies, the results of an unscheduled administrative check and how to become the owner of a spray gun for self-defense.

[h1]Weather report[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1ac5cefcc2a8e1a3c7bfa05d6b8b161002588d0f.png[/img]

Breaking news! From this day on, every resident of the Dome is obliged to listen to the weather forecast data every day. White Wing scientists have found the relationship between the weather and the activity of many anomalies.

The results of observations confirm that the electriс anomalies have grown to unprecedented sizes. It could have been caused by increased storm activity, but it’s too early for final conclusions, hundreds of hours of observations and experiments needed to be done. One thing is for sure: you can't neutralise them with simple bolts.

[h1]Management inspection[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/e6c2aa206bbedae6dda9b785cee8aa2b40ecf61f.png[/img]

Last week, CRONUS conducted a major upgrade of the entire infrastructure under the Dome. Such an important event did not go unnoticed by top management. This week, a commission of leading managers personally visited the main research facilities.

[i]"Everything went according to plan. The laboratories and research facilities have been cleaned up and put in perfect order. The equipment, furniture and equipment have been replaced with the latest models. The staff has been urgently instructed and successfully recertified. The unannounced inspection showed no signs of corruption, abuse of authority, embezzlement or financial fraud. There is only a bright future ahead for us,"[/i] said Silver Wing authorized specialist.

[h1]Self-defence items[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/248d075c435738e566047ef6ea87ced1e96f0f8a.jpg[/img]

Residents of the Dome, we are receiving more and more requests for self-defense weapons. We hurry to inform you that thanks to the recent renovation of infrastructure, the Dome has become one of the most comfortable and safe places to live on the whole planet. However, the safety and security of the settlers is a priority for CRONUS. A series of non-lethal weapons has been developed especially for employees with dubious backgrounds.

Starting today, you can send a request for a pepper spray gun. The weapon is not only easy to use, but also can easily disable your opponent for several hours thanks to the unique chemical composition of the pepper mixture. All this without significant harm to your target's health.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.821.1244: fixed perks, weapons and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/be84f5631b29cb1a332e47b431fc11978cd9c9f9.jpg[/img]

Together with the recently released Patch 3, new weapons and items, stealth movement mechanics, cool perks and... new bugs have appeared in the Encased world. This list is what issues we’ve addressed in the Hotfix.

[h2]LOCATIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the detection radius of the turrets at the "Object C12 -Nashville- Parking" location in the prologue,
[*] Fixed passability on the residential floor of the Magellan station,
[*] Fixed loot in some graves at the "Radioactive Graveyard" location,
[*] Fixed passability in the sewers of the Magellan station,
[*] Fixed passability at the “Arena" location,
[/list]

[h2]PERKS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the description of the "Wastedlander" perk,
[*] Fixed a bug when learning the "Strong Arguments" perk,
[*] Fixed the player's PDA freezing related to the "Ghost" perk,
[*] Blocked non-working perks,
[*] Fixed freezes and problems when taking a number of perks,
[/list]

[h2]WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] Archimedes Lab Belt: bonus to energy damage has been replaced by a bonus to energy resistance,
[*] Kraut nail gun: added effect of "cone" shot,
[*] Jacket from the grave: fixed AP bonus,
[*] Rebalanced buttstrokes for most weapons,
[*] Changed the characteristics of some weapons,
[*] Changed the sounds for some types of weapons,
[*] Increased the chance for the appearance of Energon, Atox and other helpful drugs at the drug stores,
[/list]

[h2]STEALTH[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stealth: fixed bugs with filling the Detection scale,
[*] Fixed the start of dialogue with some characters when the player is in stealth mode,
[/list]

[h2]GLOBAL MAP[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed markers from locations not included in Act I,
[/list]

[h2]TEXT AND LOCALIZATION[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed typos and some missing texts in the Russian and English versions of the game,
[/list]

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a unique effect for the Powerful Rollout ability,
[*] Fixed bugs related to the "Smart Home" system in the player's room on Magellan,
[*] Increased the amount of ammunition that the player receives in the Concord,
[*] Fixed the list of goods at the merchants of the New Committee,
[*] Fixed faction of Concord employees,
[*] Fixed renting a house in the Suburbs,
[*] Kurt Spengler now blocks breaking cell doors,
[*] Fixed pimp spawning in Suburb at night.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.814.2046
Massive update #3. Dome — ideal place to live in.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers, the latest issue of the CRONUS Weekly is back on your screens. Today we will report on the completion of the third stage of infrastructure construction under the Dome, we will inform you about the great achievements of our corporation, improved living and working conditions for all employees and mind blowing inventions that have changed the usual way of life.

[h1]Third update[/h1]

[previewyoutube=y9B641KBVcc;full][/previewyoutube]

The third stage of infrastructure construction under the Dome has been completed. We have joined forces of all best CRONUS specialists to make a real breakthrough in the betterment of life under the Dome. Now we can safely claim that the Dome is the best place to live on the planet. And very soon, it will reveal all its secrets to the world.

[h1]Cloaking field generators[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/35e3714ded521af070dca6233f3d5eb818b9e819.png[/img]

Thanks to the third major update, all CRONUS employees will receive personal cloaking field generators. These compact devices allow you to conduct reconnaissance special operations covertly to avoid losses among the personnel. With the stealth data you can see how much enemy attention has been drawn. Guard systems of the Forefathers, wasteland mutants and any other opponents will not even have time to notice that they’re now in our scientists' laboratories.

[h1]New weapons[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/89aebcc5fa2494cb15a7a435e47bd849f5bdca0f.png[/img]

Dome is safer than ever. But to be sure of tomorrow, CRONUS has almost completely upgraded its arsenal! New weapons with improved performance and enhanced armour-piercing capabilities, new non-lethal weapons that are perfect for scientists and pathfinders, and brand new armor and protective suits for every employee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/039f0e8c957b8e30c58c031347798e124aeb8cfe.png[/img]

In addition to that, today we launch a special offer for everyone who wants to get under the Dome. 20% discount on an unforgettable journey with our Steam partner!

notes.title: Travels, adventures and hacking into personal computers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Once again the latest issue of the CRONUS Weekly is on your screens, dive with us into the world of a great future! Today we will tell you about the future of the tourism industry, laptops and special equipment for researchers and nature scientists.

[h1]Travel to Crystal Sands[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/cf7f312ad317461546293b3e891ee0ac24a70bbe.png[/img]

Regular readers ask us, is it possible to look at the Dome with their own eyes without getting inside? Of course it is! Without further ado, we would like to show you Crystal Sands, the city of dreams built by CRONUS in a matter of months. An oasis of high technologies, growing right on the border of the Dome. This is where the journey of every new CRONUS employee begins.

It's easy to get here and see the Dome for the first time in person! Just fill out a request form at the main office, buy plane tickets and book a room in the most advanced hotels available to mankind. Crystal Sands will welcome you with open arms.

[h1]Portable computers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c1ff52e1d7351a6c0ee1715c44ba35b372566eac.png[/img]

Until recently, our computers could hardly fit in huge rooms, but now, thanks to technologies discovered under the Dome, computers have been reduced literally to the size of a wallet and are easily stored in a backpack pocket. The engineer's portable device is useful for working with terminals, fine-tuning elevators, automatic doors and other technical facilities. Its strict minimalistic design and strong metal case will make you instantly feel like a guest from the distant future.


[h1]Dart gun — protector of science[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/3a7c0fe5851c3bc95dceda1d412cf0d5060f9504.png[/img]

Joint work of Blue Wing engineers and White Wing scientists created the dart gun. This super-compact device will help researchers better understand the Dome's fauna. Its poisoned darts will deal with hostile creatures, taking the subject out of consciousness for a long time.

That way researchers will be able to capture a creature and send it to the base for detailed study of body structure and metabolism.

[b]*Attention, in case of emergency and dart hitting a person, you should see a doctor immediately. The dose can be fatal for humans.[/b]

notes.title: Invisibility and sudden maelstrom under the Dome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers, the latest issue of the CRONUS Weekly is back on your screens. Today we will tell you how the technology of the Forefathers will become part of our daily life, why weapons of the corporation do not need improvements and where it is the best place to watch amazing weather activity under the Dome.

[h1]Cloaking field generator[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/af0f88f7a38fe1f63740ee2d4ad4f10bb6f527cb.jpg[/img]

More and more of our operatives admit that they feel like heroes of fantastic novels and aliens from the distant future. This is not a euphoria, because every employee of the corporation has the most high-tech tools available to them. Who wouldn't dream of becoming invisible as a child? At CRONUS, it's possible. Based on the Forefathers' technology, Blue Wing Engineers have developed a cloaking field generator that can deceive security systems, bypass dangerous predators and safely conduct complex special operations without risking the lives of employees. All this thanks to a super-compact device with only two buttons!

Working prototypes are already successfully used in the field and soon the outside world will also get to use this amazing technology.

[h1]Weapon modifications are strictly forbidden[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c9bb811f2d2a6312ef78a05231ccae2ae879cea5.jpg[/img]

Attention all staff! CRONUS Corporation provides you with the most high-tech weapons available to mankind. Rifles, pistols, SMGs, lasers and energy guns are all available to you today. But despite this variety, some "enthusiasts" continue to make ridiculous attempts to create their own guns, collected literally from garbage. How can such devices compare in terms of power and safety with the products of our partners in arms companies?

Possession and use of improvised weapons will be discouraged at the administrative level. Violators will be subject to administrative sanctions.

[h1]Weather anomalies[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c21de0159c26779e0eeb91c815de70cd04aed41e.png[/img]

There is no place in the world more amazing than the Dome! You've probably heard of weather anomalies near the centre. Our scientists are tirelessly studying the mysterious atmospheric phenomenon. We already have first results: the maelstrom, as its observers have dubbed it, is completely safe and will not damage residential clusters or scientific bases. All we have to do is keep watching and wait for it to die down. The majestic anomaly is a real joy to watch for every Dome inhabitant. The best view is from the observation deck of the Concord Station.

notes.title: CRONUS Artifact Auction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Greetings, dear readers!

The long-awaited release of "CRONUS Weekly" is finally on your screens. Touch the future today! For you, our loyal subscribers, we offer the most valuable artifacts based on forefathers' technology at tempting prices. In addition, we will tell you about a new invention — a glove capable of concentrating your mental abilities, and offer you an adventure into an unknown world! Let’s go into details about each of today topics:

[h1]CRONUS home shopping[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aAABptCQKSw

notes.title: Useful to Know. Important CRONUS Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Greetings, dear readers!

This time your regular issue of CRONUS weekly will be extra educational. Every day you ask a lot of questions about absolutely basic things that every resident of the Dome should know. It seems that large training manuals aren’t easy to read through. In this issue, we will briefly outline the basics that every newcomer should be familiar with.

[h1]M.I.N.E.R.V.A.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/e2de402b54b17a78c0012e42ebc49e5ec97f8e2d.jpg[/img]

Readers often ask us how CRONUS manages to record, systematize and analyze the vast amount of knowledge of the forefathers. M.I.N.E.R.V.A. helps us to do this.

The intelligent computer system M.I.N.E.R.V.A. is the latest invention of our scientists and engineers.

It connects all computers under the Dome into a single network: servers, work terminals, personal communicators — everything is connected. But the main advantage of M.I.N.E.R.V.A. is an artificial intelligence, with each day it’s getting smarter and smarter thanks to the machine learning module. And thanks to regular scanning of the environment by the handheld devices, M.I.N.E.R.V.A. database is able to update constantly.

One day, it’ll be able to play chess with you or solve mysteries of the Dome. And today M.I.N.E.R.V.A. is already the best friend of any user!

[h1]CRONUS Knowledge Points[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5b9cc15997111218ca13fa0f316c868757f3413e.png[/img]

Many of you have already familiarized yourself with scanning. But did you know that CRONUS scanner is not a toy. When you scan the property of a company or its employees, both alive and dead, you get CRONUS points.

You can exchange those points for the most needed items: medical supplies, equipment and gear. It’s a support of independent research projects.

[h1]Psionics and Psi Glove[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/f859c1c066c941ff18f367354b64861a1e9fd4d1.png[/img]

As always, we left the most interesting things for last. Psionics are not yet fully understood and mastered. But thanks to painstaking work of the best scientists, many have already learned to use this energy for the benefit of the corporation. CRONUS scientists have found that each person has a special attribute in the body called Psycho. Don’t rejoice just yet, only people with the highest attributes can use Psycho in the field. Those lucky ones will need a special glove that concentrates their energy.

notes.title: Cultural Heritage under the Dome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Greetings, employees and first settlers!

Once again the latest issue of the CRONUS Weekly is on your terminal screens. In the latest issue we will tell you about some special cultural aspects under the Dome, continue to write about new weapons, as well as share new research info on artifacts of forefathers.

[h1]Cultural Heritage under the Dome[/h1]

[previewyoutube=vDMM627xN_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

The Dome brought together a huge multicultural community, representatives of many nationalities, professions and views. It brought together scientists, soldiers, office workers, former inmates and engineers to build the new complex and even brighter world.

This week, Silver Wing reporters managed to communicate with the Russian-speaking community to discuss a phenomenon called “Russian Fallout”. For better understanding of the subject, we prepared a detailed video report.

[h1]Cryo Turret of the Chimera Series[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/a467b81c57dcfb179b6c2a60bd8298495e16ad8d.png[/img]

This time, the weapon section will be continued with a brief description of a Cryo Turret. We have already told you about the Chimera Series Rocket, Shotgun and Machine gun turrets. But we've left the most interesting one for last.

Cryo Turret is the best solution for neutralizing a target. It's effective in both distance and close combat. Each unit is equipped with two powerful cryo-lasers capable of freezing anyone. If the enemy gets too close, the unit will create a cryo field of up to three meters long around it. It’s a real breakthrough in weaponcraft and artificial intelligence.

[h1]New Forefathers Relic — Fluff[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/eb4da99d84f9added4fbc45de284bf41963a3e51.png[/img]

Once again, valiant scientists delight us with new discoveries. This week, White Wing employees have studied the previously unknown Relic — Fluff. The bizarre spherical object has earned its name thanks to its unique properties.

It weighs no more than a balloon. The relic creates a field around itself that reduces the weight of objects inside it. The best minds of CRONUS are already building theories and plans to apply the miraculous properties of the artifact for the benefit of humanity. But as long as its properties are not yet fully studied, it is under strict control in the artifact storage facility. Who knows it’s true limits in ability to suppress gravity?

notes.title: New Weapon Supplies
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Greetings, dear readers!

Once again the latest issue of the CRONUS Weekly is on on your screens. Summer is in full swing, and this week we will talk about the greatest breakthroughs of the CRONUS military industry.

[h1]Chimera Series Rocket Turret[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1157682e5af28ea8605fadd092e2eacfe0f25ccf.png[/img]

Chimera series turrets have long established themselves as the best guards of your peace. That's why CRONUS decided to continue financing the development of the series. In previous editions, we talked about Defence and Gun Turrets. It's time for even more powerful ones.

Rocket Turret is ideal for fighting heavy armored enemies over long distances. Possesses increased firepower. Uses ammo similar to a grenade launcher.

[h1]Railgun, an electromagnetic mass accelerator[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/6c3b7003b3445162c845f48fcfc3f39abad60cf1.png[/img]

You often ask us how the Forefathers' technology will change weapons. Machine guns, submachine guns, shotguns and grenade launchers are all interesting, but what does the future hold? Today CRONUS armory welcomes new weapon — Railgun!

Wesley industries in collaboration with Blue Wing engineers introduced a completely new type of weapon. It is based on an electromagnetic mass accelerator that launches a conductive projectile along metal rails.

Weapon have successfully passed all field tests and received all necessary permits for mass production. Firepower and usability exceed all expectations.

[h1]Giant Insects[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/545763491467d5cb40ba5d8175c515cafcc3d0af.png[/img]

Last week, another reconnaissance unit was attacked by giant insects. Reports from the Black Wing confirm that the attack was successfully repelled. Enemy acted alone. There were no casualties or deaths.

This specimen was handed over to the White Wing researchers. According to preliminary data, the creature is ten times larger than its relatives outside the Dome. Whether we should still call them cockroaches or beetles is unknown. Scientists are planning to intensify surveillance of the flora and fauna under the Dome. Years of research, and we still know so little about the local inhabitants and how the Dome affects living organisms.

notes.title: Celebrities under the Dome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Employees, a fresh issue of "CRONUS Weekly" is once again on your screens. In this issue we will talk about the celebrities who went under the Dome, share the results of work on the new artifact, as well as talk about the summer campaign, which is taking place right now on Steam Store.

[h1]Celebrities under the Dome[/h1]

[previewyoutube=O8jh-07x7J0;full][/previewyoutube]

Dear readers, we receive more and more letters with questions about people who look like world celebrities. Is it true that world stars took such bold steps and went under the Dome, leaving the past life behind? Maybe people under the Dome just look similarly to them? Many have already encountered these employees in hallways or even noticed them working in the warehouse. We've taken a closer look and filmed a detailed report for you.

[h1]Vote Results for the Exclusive Artifact[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/77a4fa278dc7f89ac333758b417209f7bc34fcdb.jpg[/img]

As you know, for several weeks the best CRONUS scientists have been working together with first investors on the concept of a unique Artifact. Day after day they have carefully studied all the properties of the mysterious relics of the Forefathers in search of the best combination. Now we can finally sum up results of the series of votes. Take a look at "Winning Ticket"! Not only will it help you to more easily withstand critical enemy attacks, but it will also make these attacks restore your health.

All necessary blueprints have already been sent to Blue Wing, all you have to do is wait for the best engineers to collect and test the relic to authorize its use in the field.

[h1]Steam Summer Sale[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7bd75978aeb9b23855aa43e08651ecc91d848980.jpg[/img]

The world below the Dome is amazing and unfathomable. In summer it is especially beautiful. Thanks to one of our reliable partners — Steam, a journey into the mysterious world of forefathers artifacts and anomalies has become even more accessible. Right now, the annual summer sale is taking place, with thousands of companies taking part in it. We couldn't get past this event too. Until July 9th, you can buy a ticket under the Dome at a 20% discount.

That’s all for today! We’re waiting for you under the Dome!

notes.title: High security measures
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Greetings, dear subscribers!

The latest issue of the CRONUS weekly is once again on your screens. Today we will continue the theme of weapon innovations, get acquainted with the latest results of research on the impact of the Dome ecosystem on living organisms, as well as share a summary of news about the group of followers of the Maelstrom.

[h1]New Turrets of the Chimera series[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/0dd73cc79f8f2bde8d997f2972e9929d48ee7fc7.png[/img]

CRONUS Corporation values life and health of the Dome inhabitants above all. Today we present a prototype of a new security turret, which will provide additional safety and easily deal with any type of enemy.

Defence Turret is a real breakthrough in AI. Turret independently determines the number of opponents and their density in order to choose an appropriate type of attack. It uses ammo similar to shotgun.

[h1]New Insect Species[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/febbd20182f6dffdc51006029c70c6b5aaa607fb.png[/img]

Almost every day, scientists of the CRONUS white wing make amazing discoveries. But not all of them are good. This time “luck” smiled at the biologists: they conducted a thorough study of the colony of mutated roaches. It seems like that these insects evolved under the influence of anomalies. They've become larger, more dangerous and perhaps smarter. The new species is well organized and, according to research, follow commands of their Queen.

If a nest is found, do not try to destroy it yourself, immediately contact the nearest Black Wing representative. 

[h1]Fanatics Under the Dome[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/4ec950ac3da1a6002a006500bdbd8d7bd9d95f72.png[/img]

Many residents of the Dome have noticed a mysterious maelstrom. Whirlwind of an enormous size is poorly studied and looks frighteningly incomprehensible. But according to CRONUS scientists, despite its form, it is not dangerous. All stations are ready for any weather conditions and anomalies.

However, the melstrom has already made a lasting impression on some settlers and shaken their minds. So far, there is no point in worrying about a couple of crazy people or taking them seriously. All troublemakers have already been taken under special control. Silver Wing is convinced that this is just another fake excuse to slack at work.

notes.title: Arms Barons of the Dome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear employees! We dedicate this issue to our reliable partners. Their support and professionalism in tandem with patents for the highest CRONUS technologies allow us to maintain peace and order under the Dome. They are the ones who equip Black Wing employees with all the necessary equipment to serve and protect.

Don’t be afraid, though! Weapons under the Dome are only needed for training purposes or for a sense of safety while traveling through the wastelands. We assure you that life under the Dome is absolutely safe and in many ways more pleasant than in the outside world.

[h1]Seaman Inc[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/8de9c39f90e4518866067c92d691bc33db99f1f9.jpg[/img]

[b]Motto[/b]: Seaman covers you
[b]CEO[/b]: John Seaman

Brass knuckles, batons, hammers and a variety of knives, all this is supplied by Seaman Inc. Despite the high competition and availability of firearms, Seaman products are firmly established in the market thanks to Black Wing contracts. Melee weapons aid a lot in quick and almost painless suppression of riots in orange sectors. This results in lower medical costs.

[i]"Mature and serious products for mature and serious men and women,"[/i] says company CEO John Seaman.

[h1]Forge Co.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/ac6a8c3b3b7a214bd5daa028c1cb4f93aba43903.jpg[/img]

[b]Motto[/b]: Guns are fun!
[b]CEO[/b]: Quentin Glass

Futuristic and memorable, thanks to its stylish colors, weapon for everyone! It becomes even more attractive due to its reasonable price to quality ratio. You can master small caliber firearms literally in a couple of hours at the shooting range! Many residents of the Dome have already made their choice in favor of Quentin Glass company products.

Specially for women Forge Co. were among the first to launch an elegant ladies line of products, experimenting with the appearance of weapons. Whether the experiment was successful or not, it’s up to you to decide.

[h1]Danny Raynold’s Supplies[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/b7f283ed5ae44f9131b63ef2911c09278e2430bb.jpg[/img]

[b]Motto[/b]: You don’t need it, if we don’t have it.
[b]CEO[/b]: Danny Raynolds

Let's forget about knives, pistols and rifles for a time being. None of them worth a damn, without Danny's goods. Danny Raynold's Supplies produces literally all accessories and spare parts for weapons and equipment. Bullets, heavy ammo, soles of army boots and helmets, he literally makes everything.

Danny, the head of the company, is a vigorous and cheerful top manager who inspires employees to achieve new heights. Many people underestimate his role in arming the Black Wing, but in our opinion, it’s thanks to Danny's rounds and ammunition that we are able to maintain perfect order under the Dome.

Dear subscribers! These are not all corporations that help CRONUS maintain a high standard of living under the Dome. In the next issues of the newsletter, we will continue to present our leading partners. We’re eagerly waiting for your emails and comments! What do you want to learn more about? You can ask questions in response to this letter.

Stay under the Dome!

notes.title: The third stage of vote!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/6ea6d459e1645ca3fc00408eb059bd3f508a62b2.jpg[/img]

Results of the previous stage of the Kickstarter community vote are summed up and we’re ready to share them with you. With a big gap wins Relic №3!

If a user will suffer a critical hit (and a critical hit only), he won’t take any damage and will be healed for 50% of its attack power.

[i]"At the inception of Dome’s exploration, there was this pristine assuredness that here it is, the ultimate triumph of science and reason. Who would’ve guessed that its course will birth superstitions so dire that even a troglodyte would feel ashamed of following them. If we were to believe certain scouts, this relic will unfailingly ward you from death, oh, more than that, it’ll greatly improve your health in the process! And who cares if the those scouts’ leader later became a drunken, insane, self-mutilating wreck, crying that he’s “displaced” into a “wrong” Reality. And his “improved health” is a supposedly regrown long gone eye(!) that he never actually lost – we went into all the documents, all the archives, asked all the witnesses, and there were no signs of him ever being injured. Here I’m tempted to comment on the utter ineptitude of Cronus’ recruiters, but that topic is getting stale lately. Despite the absurdity of such claims, some so-called “scientists” have wasted a lot of time and resources on experimentation, with sole predictable result of murdering droves of lab animals in various creative ways. Not a single one was saved by this miraculous Relic. That was still not enough for the head of that project – that professor decided to personally bathe in this relic’s succor. Thankfully, he used a laser weapon to make a very precise hole in his cranium and, with the heat cauterizing the wound rather instantly, the following clean-up of his office was effortless. Quite a professional attitude. And yet, after all that, Relic is still a highly demanded black market commodity with plenty of fools willing to bury themselves in debt so they can “prevent” the actual burial. O tempora, o mores!"[/i]


Now, in the world under the Dome, there is a legendary artifact that can save your life from the most dangerous and sudden type of damage in RPG — critical hit.

The time has come for a new vote. Starting today and until the next week you will decide how to call such a powerful artifact. There are five choices:

[b][list]
[*] Grail
[*] Winning Ticket
[*] Crimson King
[*] Extract of Ubiquity
[*] Rune of Comfort
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Launch of transport modules and useful CRONUS notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear readers, CRONUS weekly is once again on your terminals! Today we will tell you about the launch of new transport modules, share notes about scientific studies of the corporation, as well as summarize the first stage of vote for unique items.

[h1]Launch of transport modules[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/0a1ad428ef95a022140919e2243f25c2c7ce996a.png[/img]

Getting under the Dome is a fascinating but also dangerous journey. When you arrive to the Spire station, built around an aperture at the top of the Dome, you will have a long descent. But the well-coordinated work of the world's best engineers allowed CRONUS to build a real engineering marvel in the shortest possible time, an updated system of transport modules. The blue wing was so confident in its invention that one of the first testers was a leading design engineer.

"Trampoline works!" - the first words of the Blue Wing Director, after a successful landing.

[h1]Useful CRONUS notes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/61a6098163a049a51aa75d42c8bf5053a9fbe479.jpg[/img]

Once under the Dome, forget everything you've been taught. Whether you were a military man, a medic, a leader, or a simple worker, everyone will have to undergo basic military training.

In this dangerous world, everyone must be able to use weapons. However, experience has proven that, this is not enough. For those who wish to continue training in combat disciplines, CRONUS has published special books, from which you will learn more about the weaknesses of the coming opponents, factional relations or even about how relics and anomalies work. These materials are absolutely free and available to everyone.

[h1]Vote for the exclusive item: part 2[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7f928b83208602cbcac4317442b42ef732ac99c1.jpg[/img]

The results of the first stage of vote for the unique and exclusive item are already here! The winner is the Relic of the Forefathers.

CRONUS Corporation has already launched the second stage of vote, in which our first investors will choose features and characteristics of the future relic. If you have supported us on Kickstarter, do not pass by. You will find the link to the second stage of the voting in your email inbox and in personal messages on the Kickstarter website.

See you under the Dome!

notes.title: Vote results and what’s next!
notes.content:
The results of the first stage of the Encased Kickstarter Community vote for the unique and exclusive item are already here! The winner is the Forefathers' Relic.

Today we launch the second stage, in which Kickstarter backers will choose features and attributes of the future relic, there are three descriptions to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7f928b83208602cbcac4317442b42ef732ac99c1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Relic #1[/h2]
While using it, Character receives +15% Cold Resistance. Starting from the second combat round, Relic begins to emit cold discharges that damages both the user and all the characters within one tile of him.

"Same goes for the space near it – due to that, Relic is a rare occurrence, but an easy find. As soon as it contacts air it begins to emit rhythmic “pulses”, each pulse absorbing heat from everything in near vicinity. Despite this process, the temperature of relic itself remains unchanged and there’s no clear indication as to where all that disappearing energy goes. Pulses occur without any noises or flashes and the crystallization of air humidity is the sole indication of the danger it poses – an unprepared human will be frozen to death in just a couple of pulses. Few people are brave enough to use it in the combat conditions – in some way, relic does recognize its bearer and tries to shield him a bit, but only a little. You have to be extremely cool-headed to risk that much."

[h2]Relic #2[/h2]
This relic will influence all organic combatants, making them lose 20% Accuracy.

"In happier times Relic was used as a part of a hazing ritual for White Wing newcomers. The setup of that was deceptively mundane – the victim was led to a lab where this relic was contained under a closed casing. Then they were left alone while being asked to fill a standardized form with some ordinary observations and other routine stuff, the case being opened upon their exit. Half an hour past that, the hazers returned to find all the forms spoiled, criss-crossed with unrecognizable scribble, and the totally panicked victim running in circles, being unable to find the door out. Relic disrupts one’s perception of surrounding reality and it directly affects the processes inside the brain itself – videotaping and similar ways of recording do not fixate anything wrong near it. People, however, will perceive everything as being “correct” while that “everything” is actually dreadfully wrong. Even the most basic tasks might become impossible while under its influence, so the only way to study this relic is while using remotely-controlled devices. Relic is especially adept at masking itself, and so it’s completely futile to understand anything about it in person. All the accompanying fun was eventually banned, though – for one newbie, thirty minutes was more than enough to become stark-raving mad and to greet a chuckling returnee with an unbelievably pinpoint pen to the eye. But that’s a different story."

[h2]Relic #3[/h2]
If a user will suffer a critical hit (and a critical hit only), he won’t take any damage and will be healed for 50% of its attack power.

"At the inception of Dome’s exploration, there was this pristine assuredness that here it is, the ultimate triumph of science and reason. Who would’ve guessed that its course will birth superstitions so dire that even a troglodyte would feel ashamed of following them. If we were to believe certain scouts, this relic will unfailingly ward you from death, oh, more than that, it’ll greatly improve your health in the process! And who cares if the those scouts’ leader later became a drunken, insane, self-mutilating wreck, crying that he’s “displaced” into a “wrong” Reality. And his “improved health” is a supposedly regrown long gone eye(!) that he never actually lost – we went into all the documents, all the archives, asked all the witnesses, and there were no signs of him ever being injured. Here I’m tempted to comment on the utter ineptitude of Cronus’ recruiters, but that topic is getting stale lately. Despite the absurdity of such claims, some so-called “scientists” have wasted a lot of time and resources on experimentation, with sole predictable result of murdering droves of lab animals in various creative ways. Not a single one was saved by this miraculous Relic. That was still not enough for the head of that project – that professor decided to personally bathe in this relic’s succor. Thankfully, he used a laser weapon to make a very precise hole in his cranium and, with the heat cauterizing the wound rather instantly, the following clean-up of his office was effortless. Quite a professional attitude. And yet, after all that, Relic is still a highly demanded black market commodity with plenty of fools willing to bury themselves in debt so they can “prevent” the actual burial. O tempora, o mores!"

If you are the [b]Encased Kickstarter backer[/b], then you should definitely participate. In your mailbox and in personal messages on the Kickstarter you will find a link to the second stage of voting.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Welcome, employees and first settlers! The weekly CRONUS Newsletter is with you again! In today's issue:

- Details of new anomalies detected under the Dome.
- A first look at improved equipment for CRONUS military
- Voting for exclusive item for the founding fathers of the corporation.

[h2]Ash anomaly — a new death trap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/ea710be0e9f746c2252ac614201f76f138282869.gif[/img]

We'll start with the news marked “news flash”! Journalists managed to get a fresh video from the best White Wing scientists. You can see with your own eyes a completely new type of anomaly, previously unknown to science and mankind.

Anomaly is poorly studied, even leading scientists are not ready to give an accurate assessment of its origin. Only one thing is certain: it is extremely dangerous to any nearby life!

A scientific team has already moved to the place of formation of the mysterious object. We closely follow the work of the team and will certainly provide a detailed report on its properties in one of the next issues.

[i][b]Note: to speed up anomaly research, White Wing is looking for [strike]guinea pigs[/strike] volunteers from the Orange Wing.[/b][/i]

[h2]New equipment[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/8a78f39e6317c47c1f59c1a9011bbd3bee31d546.jpg[/img]

Black Wing employees were shown a prototype of new combat equipment. Right now it is only a prototype, but the first tests have already been scheduled. Results will decide if it’ll go into mass production. The equipment should facilitate the movement of infantry units in the wastelands, as well as reduce load and increase mobility in combat environment.

[h2]Vote for exclusive item[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/a479c40cc046563eb95c0afdce23086c8ffd0470.jpg[/img]

It's time for more rewards! CRONUS Corporation has launched a series of votes for an in-game item exclusive to first investors! The voting will be split in four stages. After results are summed up, the item will be designed by the best Blue Wing engineers as unique and created by the Dome community.

The first stage of voting has already begun! Choose the main type of future equipment. We offer several options: Weapon, Armor Element, or Forefathers Relic.

Company management never forgets the first employees who supported the start of research through the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/darkcrystalgames/encased-old-school-isometic-turn-based-rpg]crowdfunding platform[/url]. We want to thank everyone for your support. Without you, the future would not be so close!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Today you read the [b]30th Anniversary Edition[/b] of the CRONUS Newsletter on your terminals. Every week we share the hottest news from under the Dome, and your letters and reviews help us raise the bar even higher!

In this issue, we will dispel rumors about the irradiation of employees with new radio towers, share emotions from the victory in two categories at an international conference, as well as provide a fresh report of the Blue Wing on recent improvements.

Stay with us!

[h1]CRONUS has installed next generation radio towers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/f1c825fd063bdbb2c63b633e8cb11446053e94bb.jpg[/img]

Dear Employees! The administration noticed an increase in the number of complaints about the health of the staff. Provocateurs are trying to link this with the installation of new radio towers. We ask you not to trust unverified information!

CRONUS corporation assures that the towers do not cause mental disorders. Moreover, we strongly recommend that anyone who feels that the towers are causing mental disorders should contact the White Wing for help. Years spent in isolation under the Dome may not have passed without a trace.

[h1]Two victories at DevGAMM[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/f68d951af310373facf72a86b9c77c17b92ea458.jpg[/img]

Our best specialists take part in it annually, and this time was no exception. This time our employees outdid themselves, winning in two categories at once, among which is the main prize of the conference.

CRONUS wants to thank all residents of the Dome for support and emotions they give us. This is our common victory.

Steam, one of the main partners of the corporation, announced a temporary 20% discount on a trip under the Dome. Hurry up to see with your own eyes the large-scale changes that have taken place in the wastelands: new jobs, mysterious technologies of the Forefathers, wild areas and the most modern equipment. notes.title: Hotfix 4 - A lot of new fixes
Cockroach invasion and problems with fuel delivery to the Dome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear employees!

Newest issue of C.R.O.N.U.S. weekly touched upon the most serious problems of the Dome that have arisen since the renovation. We’ll talk about the invasion of cockroaches and the measures taken by the leadership to fight this plague. We'll share the news about the serious problems with fuel delivery. And, as always, we will present a report on the work done over the past week.

[h1]Cockroach invasion[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/fcf89ad16d1c82aa700d826cb186346d98cb6d1b.png[/img]
Cockroaches. Perhaps the most pressing problem at the moment under the Dome. Invasion of these disease spreaders is a hot topic right now. Unconfirmed reports indicate that some of them are reaching colossal sizes. They are extremely aggressive and ferocious. The chances of surviving to meet them are almost zero.

We were able to contact and talk to the head of the disinfection commission.

"We know of the problem, an emergency committee has already been assembled. All necessary measures to curb the spread of insects have already been taken. The nests have been localized and destroyed. Of course, no giant species has been sighted. Oranges just like to spread false rumors and over exaggerate problems," said the head of the commission.

[h1]Fuel shortage[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/ae16d610cee47dd594af39df5aa650ed9db4c6c3.png[/img]
Dear employees! Many of you have noticed a sudden rise of fuel prices. Some of you have even given up on personal transport. As you know, the external world is in a very unstable economic situation. As a result, fuel supplies to the Dome have been temporarily suspended. The C.R.O.N.U.S. Corporation strongly recommends that you temporarily quit using personal vehicles. Everyone will be offered a free parking at Magellan station warehouses. As Silver Wing employees assure, there are enough resources and technology under the Dome to achieve full energy autonomy.

[h1]New report from Blue Wing engineers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/cd6d3a281892da8edfbf81cbe1504284a936da46.png[/img]
Residents of the Dome! Technical work of the Blue Wing does not stop for a single day. The best engineers are relentlessly fighting against all the flaws around, following your observations. This week we are publishing a detailed report on the work done for our subscribers. A full list of changes can be found by clicking on a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/921800/announcements/detail/2205018422376588170]link[/url].

[h1]Breaking news from the outside world[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5f2d3c737e4a64f6663448707e214be4f19c59a2.jpg[/img]
Attention all employees! The world of Sin Slayers is under a threat again. The enemy is well known to you. This time, the XBOX ONE console has been assigned to the battlefield against the cursed souls of sinners. We hope you've brought it with yourself under the dome.

The main expedition is scheduled for May 8. In the meantime, you have time to thoroughly prepare for the battle and buy all necessary materials at a [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/sin-slayers-enhanced-edition/9pp2jf647sx8?activetab=pivot:overviewtab]20% discount[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix 3: fixing critical problems, main quest and much more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/4cae98d16f58535fbf12935332dc252bfdc28661.jpg[/img]

We have released a new update for Encased. Version 0.17.428.1756 has many important bug fixes that include the critical ones for the playthrough.

We take this opportunity to thank you for your activity in social networks and on the Steam page. We read every comment and report, and try to take into account each opinion. Thank you for helping us to make Encased better!

[h3]List of changes:[/h3]

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Load time for locations has been significantly reduced,
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Weapon no longer loses durability. Weapons maintenance mechanics will be added at a later date.,
[*] Zip lines in the suspicious cave and on the location with a bandit ambush has been changed.
[*] Fixed levels and factions of many merchants,
[/list]
[h1]Bugs and freezes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Combat: Fixed freezes that occurred during enemy movement,
[*] Fixed errors that led to unjustified NPC hostility on Magellan,
[*] Fixed freezes while talking to Sam Bossman,
[*] Fixed a bug where Russo didn't take an abnormal essence,
[*] Fixed second experience gain in dialogue with Beatrice Catcher,
[*] Fixed Barry Robins night behavior,
[*] Fixed game freezes associated with some status effects,
[*] Redesigned the mechanism of drawing the roofs of buildings, removed the bug in which the roof continued to be drawn when the player's character was under it,
[*] Combat: Fixed aiming error,
[*] Fixed freezes while loading a quick save during combat,
[*] Fixed freezes while loading of Magellan laboratory floor,
[*] Fixed freezes in the random encounter with robokids,
[/list]
[h1]Location changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Magellan, lab floor: wounded Holiday now lying on a carriage,
[*] Magellan, lab floor: fixed level passability,
[*] Magellan, lab floor: recorder is now working correctly,
[*] Magellan, warehouse: bug that allowed Holiday's servo shell to be worn has been fixed,
[*] Magellan, Living floor: fixed level passability,
[*] Magellan, Reception: fixed level passability,
[*] Magellan, Administration: fixed level passability,
[*] Magellan, reactor room: added social animation for Oranges,
[*] Nashville, excavation area: fixed level passability,
[*] Abandoned bunker: fixed level passability, the terminal is now available,
[*] Roadside Picnic: fixed level passability, box on the cafe roof is now openable,
[*] Roadside Picnic, basement: improved lighting,
[*] Visual appearance of the "Destination point" location has been significantly improved,
[*] Bottom of the observation deck: roof rendering has been fixed,
[*] Concord station: Sebastian Van Alden now returns to his place once player completes briefing,
[*] Roadside Picnic: characters Swallow and Rabinat Krishnaswamy got unique portraits,
[*] Roadside Picnic: fixed turret placement,
[*] Roadside Picnic: you can now find an enhanced version of the Kraut Pneumatic Nail Gun on the location,
[*] Roadside Picnic: fixed ladder interaction,
[*] Roadside Picnic: fixed level passability,
[*] Junktown: fixed the reward for buried treasure,
[*] Nashville, excavation area: added a minimap for the cave after the incident.,
[*] Nashville, excavation area: fixed visual artifacts,
[*] Magellan, Parking: Improved location appearance,
[*] Arena: location fixed, old decorations removed, visual artifacts removed,
[*] Cliff: Fixed freezes while going downhill,
[/list]
[h1]Balance and items[/h1]
[list]
[*] Items: fixed the description of attributes for armor-piercing pistol ammo,
[*] Items: fixed issues with DLC items handout while talking to the storekeeper,
[*] Items: weight of Airgun ammo corrected.,
[*] Balance: fatigue removal with Energon has been fixed.,
[*] Balance: Requirements for "Stuff with Lead" and "Igniting Shot" abilities have been fixed,
[*] Balance: skills progression in the branch "Hand-to-hand combat" is fixed,
[*] Fixed weight of many keys,
[/list]
[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] UI: fixed the size of the slider in the settings while switching the language,
[*] UI: locations that have been mapped on the Dome global map, but have not yet been studied, are now displayed in the list of locations in the global map interface,
[*] Fixed display of the main menu on some graphics cards,
[*] Fixed marker appearance of Magellan's parking lot and Roadside Picnic in Act 1,
[/list]
[h1]Random Encounters[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added illustrations to random encounters on Fuel Station,
[*] Fixed exploits with endless experience and relict dust farm on "Relict Wall" location,
[/list]
[h1]Dialogues, quests and localization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added checks in Akira's dialog after the completion of the "Imprinting" quest,
[*] Fixed the bug with the magazine in the robot baby event,
[*] Fixed Henrietta Russo's dialogue on the Emulator project location,
[*] Requirements for the "technitian" skill in an event with an undertaker have been reduced,
[*] Fixed Hill Spencer's dialogue,
[*] Fixed dialogue with Krump in the bar,
[*] Fixed Theresa's second greeting in the bar,
[*] Fixed Rick McDougal's dialogue portrait,
[*] Fixed dialogue with Audrey Melville,
[*] Fixed Martin Kingsley's quests and dialogue in Act 1,
[*] Fixed the portrait of the character in the dialogs on the Kaleidoscope location,
[*] Fixed playback of prisoner dialogues in the suspicious cave,
[*] Fixed a number of typos in English localization,
[*] Fixed a typo in an abandoned bunker note,
[*] Fixed the portrait in Tim Ginzburg's dialogue on the Nashville residential floor,
[*] Fixed security guard dialogue on the Concord station while using turngate after talking to Kingsley.

notes.title: Return of research teams
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

"News from under the Dome" are once again here! This week we’ll tell you how new and old employees experienced changes under the Dome. We’ll show work results of the group of artists, and invite you to participate in C.R.O.N.U.S. secret experiments.

[h1]C.R.O.N.U.S. for everyone [/h1]

[previewyoutube=DtlRqr0ZiMo;full][/previewyoutube]

Dear, employees!

Work at C.R.O.N.U.S. is not only about scientific research and high technology, not just building houses or studying anomalies. The corporation values art as much as it values technology, and understands its importance for the future closed ecosystem.

We present you one of the last works of artists who in search of inspiration went to the mysterious land under the Dome, leaving the familiar life behind. Looking at the results, we can already safely say that they made the right decision. We have filmed the entire process of creating a masterpiece that will inspire our and future generations to great achievements.

[h1]Closed test site returns[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/92cb2adc07c66144a365477fc4edad36f8f90f50.png[/img]

Second major update of the Dome infrastructure came out last week. Not only newcomers, but also experienced stalkers were interested in new territories, anomalies and technologies.

We also reopen special test sites for all enthusiasts where you can better prepare for the ruthless conditions of the wastelands.

As before, any employee of the corporation can take part in tests. We have prepared a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/921800/view/2205018422354861068]special instruction[/url] on how to get a pass to closed areas.

[i]Reminder. During the tests, you may encounter unexplored creatures, technologies and anomalies. C.R.O.N.U.S. is not responsible for your safety inside the test area.[/i]

[h1]Work under the Dome doesn’t stop[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/b16a273f4a173b5a5b6b645fbb2d8c34c8015daf.jpg[/img]

After the update under the Dome, came new residents and staff, buildings were created and old premises were expanded. Of course, such changes are impossible without slight mistakes. Thanks to your vigilance, the best Blue Wing specialists are fixing problems in no time.

We have already submitted [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/921800/view/3278000488980974441]two reports[/url] detailing the work done and more is yet to come. We read all your feedback and comments carefully, and the work on the next fixes has already begun.

Thank you for your contribution for the brighter tomorrow! Stay under the Dome!

notes.title: Test branch is once again live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7d1e5081d1030b6e0597ffd0995090d9b461754d.jpg[/img]

Greetings, employees!

The second major update came out a week ago. It means that not only veterans, but also newcomers have returned to the Dome to explore the wastelands and abnormal areas. Patch introduced many changes, and work on Encased doesn't stop for a minute.

For all enthusiasts, we decided to revive the public-test branch of the game called "public-test". On this branch the game will be filled with small changes every day. Join us there if you don’t like to wait for large updates!

[b][i]While playing on a public testing branch, you may encounter unfinished game elements that may negatively affect your gaming experience.[/i][/b]

[h3]To download the patch from the test branch, you need to do the following:[/h3]

[list]
[*] You may need to restart Steam;
[*] Right-click on Encased in your Library and chose Properties;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/613833fcefe74eeb1d343d1f18439641d64c82d0.png[/img]
[*] Switch to the Betas tab and select public-test in the dropdown;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/52ed1ef12044df97cad40cef5f23dc7b5eb121a7.png[/img]
[*] Click Close;
[*] The game should start updating now, but if this does not happen - restart Steam.
[/list]

Of course, the release version of the hotfix will differ from the test one in a number of changes, but saves from the test branch will remain compatible. (However, to be safe, make a copy of them upfront).

notes.title: The day has finally come! Massive update under the Dome!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Greetings, employees!

If you've been postponing your trip under the Dome for a long time, then now is the time! Over the past week, the world has changed a lot. All thanks to the dedicated work of the staff of each wing. New settlers can expect new jobs and areas for exploration, the most technologically advanced equipment and facilities like no other in the world.

[h3]Station Overhauls[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/54485573942959425c0e623f44f3e4b169105e76.jpg[/img]
In the latest issue of the newsletter, we announced a change in the management of the Concord Station. It's time to see how the station has changed with the new management.

We can't believe how the station has transformed in a couple of days. Newly opened facilities, flooded with new lamps, created additional jobs. The quality of equipment was increased, and modern machines have replaced the old ones. New designer furniture in the recreation areas is so nice, we want to take hundreds of photos on it to send to loved ones outside the Dome! Be sure to visit the Concord again to see how good the station has become.

But that's no reason to stop here. What matters to C.R.O.N.U.S. is taking care of its employees. Remember, the future of the Dome and all humanity is in our hands. Send your feedback and wishes to us, no letter will be ignored, you can be sure about that.

[h3]New enemies in the wastelands[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7ea9d8bd0bb20ade4f0844754dc4de1c01832235.png[/img]
Absolutely legal and safe experiments on the Dome animals resulted in a breakthrough in the protection of strategically important objects. Modified cyber-hyenas were 10 times better than human counterparts in conducted tests. Needless to say, it will significantly reduce security costs. Saved money will be distributed somewhere else to the benefit of employees.

[i]*Some specimens managed to escape and leave the test site. Be careful during your research. Cyber Hyenas are equipped with the most powerful weapons and are very deadly.
[/i]

[h3]Press tours under the Dome[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/962aeda0fea7b1dd3ae27b6369c17fd2e6ced570.jpg[/img]
We are confident that the discoveries made under the Dome will change the future of humanity forever. Therefore, we invite journalists and observers from all over the world to visit us. Having contacted our press services you can make [url=https://encasedgame.com/keyrequest]an application for a free trip to wastelands[/url], modern settlements, scientific objects and other possessions of the corporation. Remember, you will never want to leave the Dome!
